Dungeon Gadgets

Free tools for the game master's table

GitHub

Which tool do you need?

All three are free and run in your browser

  • Dungeon Tracker

    Run a dungeon crawl

    Counts 10-minute turns, rolls for wandering monsters and logs each encounter.

    Open Tracker tracker.dungeongadgets.com

  • Lineage

    Build a family tree

    Maps a character's ancestry across generations, from founders to heirs.

    Open Lineage lineage.dungeongadgets.com

  • Token Forge

    Make tokens for a VTT

    Cuts round tokens for Roll20, Foundry and Owlbear Rodeo. Images stay on your device.

    Open Token Forge tokenforge.dungeongadgets.com

About

Dungeon Gadgets is a set of free utilities for game masters, made by Sectr99. Each one does a single job.
